deploy.startCommand: /bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; key_file="${PAPERCLIP_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY_FILE:-/paperclip/instances/default/secrets/master.key}"; key_value="${PAPERCLIP_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY:-${PAPERCLIP_MASTER_KEY:-}}"; if [ -n "$key_value" ]; then mkdir -p "$(dirname "$key_file")"; printf "%s" "$key_value" > "$key_file"; chmod 600 "$key_file"; fi; exec node --max-old-space-size=450 dist/index.js'
